title: Lucky Luke and the Daltons.
lines: In the Wild West of America it's hot and dry.
Balls of dry grass roll across the road.
A cowboy is riding his horse there.
He has a yellow shirt, a black waistcoat and a white hat.
His horse is called Jolly Jumper.
Jolly Jumper is white with a yellow mane.
Lucky Luke is the fastest cowboy in the West.
He's faster than his own shadow!
One day Lucky Luke rides into a little town.
Joe is the smallest, but he's the boss.
He always gets angry very quickly.
He's sweet but a bit silly.
There's also a dog with Lucky Luke.
His name is Rin Tin Can.
Rin Tin Can is the silliest dog in the West.
Lucky Luke follows the Daltons' tracks.
A small one, a medium one, a big one and a really big one.
The tracks lead to the bank.
The Daltons want to rob the bank!
He knows that Averell is always hungry.
He puts a big pan of beans and bacon in front of the bank door.
We have to rob the bank!
The other brothers want a taste too.
They all sit down around the pan.
He catches all four Daltons with one rope.
Joe stamps his feet with rage.
The Daltons go back to prison.
The people of the town cheer.
Can I take the rest of the beans with me?
He rides away into the setting sun.
And he sings: I'm a poor lonely cowboy, far from home.
